input.behavior_to_protect: A pipe character inside single quotes must not split the pipeline into a new stage.

description: Write one regression scenario where a pipeline string contains a '|' inside single quotes and the parser must produce exactly one stage rather than two. The scenario must fail a mutant that splits on every '|' character.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
